[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:385YE Spring]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Mitwold, Seconded: Kallavesa">To commission the folly "Lowther's Lift", within the Singing Caves, near Overton in Mournwold. This folly would enable the extraction of greater quantities of mithril in the form of a ministry. This will cost 10 wains of weirwood and 20 crowns. This is self funded.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[folly|lift]] that allows access to rich new veins of [[mithril]], as detailed in the '''[[Wildest_dreams#The_Deep_Mine|Wildest dreams]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed

==Date==
* Spring 385YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per wind of fortune
* 15 wains of weirwood
* 20 crowns in labour costs
* Six months to construct

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Lowther%27s_Lift}}
==Outcome==
* Once completed it will grant the [[Singing Caves|Custodian of the Singing Caves]] access to a new ministry to purchase wains of mithril at set prices.
* Following the [[Shallows_and_miseries#Meanwhile_in_Mournwold|actions of Yanya Uranduln]] the lifts require another five wains of [[weirwood]] and will take another three months
